full_judgment: 41. Let us now examine the sufficiency of the respondents' return. It is true that a presumption is attached to Annexure-1 and 2, the respondents' two official papers, that they were regularly made, but in no sense they can prove the conviction challenged in this ease. The warrant of commitment was produced before the High. Court Division without any affirmed statement by the ADM or any other person competent to affirm on his behalf as to the manner of its issuance. The warrant, issued by one not authorized under the law, can hardly prove the conviction.
